title: Pumpkin Seed and Sesame Seed Milk
steps: Soak pumpkin seeds and sesame seeds in water for 4–6 hours or overnight.
Add the soaked seeds with 750 ml fresh water to a blender and blend for 30–40 seconds until smooth.
Strain the mixture using a muslin cloth, or fine sieve to separate the milk from the pulp. Mix honey, cinnamon and sea salt in thr milk!
Transfer the milk to a glass bottle and refrigerate. It stays fresh for 2–3 days. Dont heat this!!!
Add to Rotis / Parathas/Pancakes, mix pulp with atta to make high-fiber magnesium-rich rotis.
Energy Bites- Combine with: dates, cocoa powder, peanut butter.
Add 1–2 tbsp pulp to smoothies for extra minerals and fiber.
assumptions: Costs Rs 50/750 ml. The creator’s figures are approximate.
